ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  5paisa Capital Limited announced the resignation of Mr. Ameya Agnihotri, its Whole-Time Director and Chief Technology Officer, effective September 30, 2026, to pursue external career opportunities. This departure creates a significant leadership void in a critical technology role for the fintech company, potentially impacting its strategic tech development and operational continuity. While no other material reasons were disclosed, investors should monitor the company's succession planning and any subsequent impact on its technology roadmap.
